description: Compiles all pages (or active page) into a print-ready, high-resolution multi-page PDF document and triggers client-side download.

allPages.description: Whether to compile all pages into 1 multi-page PDF (true) or active page only (false)

scale.description: Rendering scale multiplier (1 = Standard 72 DPI, 2 = Retina 150 DPI, 3 = Print 300 DPI, 4 = Maximum)
